title: The Carry Curve
description: Cumulative net carry of a $10k delta-neutral perpetual funding harvest over real Hyperliquid funding regimes. The line starts below zero by the round-trip fee, then climbs at the annualized funding rate; a flip slider rolls it over. Carry, not alpha — until funding inverts.
controls: tap a funding regime to load its real rate
drag on the chart (or arrow keys) to set the holding period
drag the fee slider to set the round-trip cost
drag the flip slider to make funding reverse sign

dataSource.label: Hyperliquid funding docs + perp.wiki / bitsgap funding snapshots (2026)
